title: Topic 9
japanese_text: 彼は時間に<u>ルーズで</u>度々仲間を<u>いら立たせて</u>いるが、どこか<u>憎めない</u>、<u>人懐っこい</u>性格なので、嫌われることもなく今もマイペースに生きている。
english_translation: He is rather loose with time and often irritates others, but he is somehow impossible to hate and quite amiable, so no-one dislikes him and he just goes along at his own pace.
